name: Bear Hunt
description: After the kindling embers goal is achieved, alliances build the hunting trap and hunt the raging bear. Members have 30 minutes to defeat it once activated. Rewards improve with the troop damage dealt to the bear.
frequency: An R4 or R5 can activate it every two days. An alliance can summon the bear every 47.5 hours.
requirements: Alliance level 5 or higher to build the event building
R4 or R5 rank to activate the event
A player can take part again from the start of the second calendar day after their participation day (server time, UTC)
tips: Collect arrowheads from looting beasts to raise damage by 25% (maximum level 5).
All stats and skills of the rally captain's three heroes take effect.
Troop formation composition matters by troop type.
Keep the rally window open to join faster.
Save several hero formations for flexibility.
Jessie, Jasser, and Jeronimo give a stacking 25% damage bonus.
